_note: 1권 새 대본(docs/16-script-b1.md)의 그림 프롬프트·대사. build/tmp/v2_gen.py 가 읽어 장면을 만들고 유닛 JSON 에 넣는다. {PIP} {BUN} {HED} {GRUMBLE} 는 캐릭터 설명으로, {cat} 처럼 소문자는 그 단어 그림(참조 시트)과 같은 동물로 바뀐다. who: narrator·bun·hedgie·pip·grumble·both(번+헤지 함께)

panels.desc: {BUN} and {HED} crouch by a low stone garden wall, discovering a small round wooden door at its base; warm sunlight spills through the gap under the door.
The little round door stands open. Inside is a sunny garden with clay flower pots; on one pot sits {PIP}, very small. {BUN} and {HED} peek in through the doorway with delighted faces.
{PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} stand in a circle in the garden waving at each other happily. In the bottom corner, two round eyes peek out of a dark hole in the ground.

{GRUMBLE} has climbed out of the hole holding a small lantern, one finger pressed to his lips. {BUN} and {HED} cover their mouths with their paws. Tiny {PIP} stands on the pot with its beak wide open, singing loudly.

A garden bus stop: a small round sign post with a plain arrow symbol. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} stand together holding one big blue bag between them, looking right. A yellow bus is arriving from the right. A small cup sits on a bench.
The yellow bus has stopped and its door is open. {cat} steps off the bus carrying a small red bag in its mouth. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch with wide curious eyes.
Close view: {cat} has opened the small red bag on the grass; inside is one shiny red apple. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} lean in close, eyes wide with delight, mouths open.
{cat} sits back full and happy with a licked-clean apple core beside it. Tiny {PIP} holds a single green leaf and stares at it, puzzled. {BUN} and {HED} stand with surprised open mouths.

A small garden pond. {duck} sits on a nest at the water's edge on top of one big white egg. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} tiptoe closer, watching carefully. A small dog drinks at the far side of the pond; a doll lies in the grass.
panels.text: The duck is on the egg.

panels.desc: {frog} has hopped up to the nest and pokes the big white egg with one finger. {duck} looks cross. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} gasp. A fork and a small bowl sit on a picnic cloth nearby; {GRUMBLE} watches from his hole holding a paper fan.
Close view of the nest: the big white egg is wobbling with a crack across it. {duck}, {frog}, {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} all lean in holding their breath, eyes wide. A tiny elf hat hangs on a bush.

The egg has hatched: a fluffy yellow duckling sits on top of {frog}'s back, hugging it. {frog} looks startled. {duck} smiles. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} laugh. A small garden shed door is open in the background.
panels.text: The duck is on the frog!

panels.desc: {HED} proudly hugs a big gift box tied with a red ribbon in the garden. {PIP} and {BUN} admire it. A hen pecks by the fence; a hammer leans on the shed wall.
{goat} walks up and sniffs the gift box in {HED}'s arms. {HED} looks worried, {BUN} points, {PIP} hides behind {BUN}. A hippo peeks over the pond edge; a small ink bottle sits on a garden table.

{goat} is chewing the ribbon and wrapping paper of the gift box, scraps everywhere. {HED} throws up his paws in dismay. {PIP} and {BUN} gasp. A tiny insect sits on a flower; a small white igloo-shaped dog house stands in the corner.
The wrapping is gone and a shiny acoustic guitar has appeared. {goat} holds the guitar and strums it happily; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} dance around it with big smiles.
A small wooden door in the garden wall has a big brass padlock on it. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} stand in front of it, puzzled. A kite flies high in the sky.
On a garden table: a glass bowl of wobbly red jelly, and inside the jelly a brass key is visible. {HED} points at it excitedly; {PIP} and {BUN} look. A glass of juice and a lemon sit on the table.
{BUN} and {HED} jump high in the air beside the table, pulling the sticky key out of the jelly; jelly wobbles everywhere. {PIP} cheers from the table edge.
The little door is open. Inside, {koala} is fast asleep curled up with one sock on its leg. {GRUMBLE} stands beside the door with a finger on his lips; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} tiptoe quietly.
{PIP} walks alone along a garden path under an apple tree with red apples, looking up happily. A yellow bus toy and a bag sit by the path.
{PIP} stands at the pond edge watching {duck} and {frog} sitting together on a lily pad. An egg and a paper fan lie on the bank.
panels.text: I see a duck and a frog.

panels.desc: {goat} runs across the lawn flying a big red kite on a string; {PIP} watches amazed. A gift box, a guitar and a hen are around the lawn.
{PIP} has grabbed the kite string and is lifted into the sky, flapping; {BUN} and {HED} run below jumping to catch it. A key, a lock and a lemon lie on the grass.
Night garden under a big full moon. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} sit on the pond bank looking up; the moon is reflected in the still water. {monkey} sits on a branch holding a glass of milk.
{otter} arrives carrying a fishing net on a pole and leans over the pond toward the moon's reflection. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch curiously. A plate with nine olives sits on the bank.

{otter} swings the net into the pond; water splashes; something round is caught in the net under the moonlight. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} lean forward with open mouths. {GRUMBLE} peeks from his hole with a bandage on his nose.
panels.text: The moon is in the net!

panels.desc: The net is lifted: inside is {octopus} with its eight arms dangling out, blinking. {otter} looks embarrassed. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} laugh. The moon still shines above.

Rain falls on the garden. {duck} wearing a small golden crown stands dripping wet and sad under the rain. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch from under a big leaf. A pencil lies on the windowsill of the shed.
{panda} arrives carrying a big patchwork quilt and wraps it around {duck} who wears the crown. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} smile. A flower pot and a bowl of rice sit by the shed.
panels.text: The queen is in a quilt.

panels.desc: {duck} with the crown, wrapped in the quilt, looks up at {panda} and opens her beak as if asking; {panda} scratches his head shyly. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} wait. A toy rocket stands in the grass far away.
{panda} opens his mouth wide, quacking; a line of five ducks waddles behind {panda} following him. {duck} with the crown laughs; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} cheer. The rain has stopped.
A bright sunny day with a big round sun. {turtle} walks slowly along the garden path holding a striped umbrella over its head. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch from the lawn.
A gust of wind: the umbrella lifts {turtle} off the ground; {turtle} dangles from the umbrella handle, surprised. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} point up with open mouths.
{turtle} floats high in the blue sky under the umbrella. Below, {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} run across the garden chasing it. An old raccoon uncle with a hat sits on a bench watching.
{turtle} has landed with a splash inside a huge bowl of tomato soup on a picnic table; {seal} holds a spoon, astonished. A tomato sits beside the bowl. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} arrive laughing.
panels.text: The turtle is in the soup!

panels.desc: {fox} wearing a small blue vest stacks six cardboard boxes into a tall pointed mountain on the lawn. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} watch. A sign with a red cross hangs on the shed (a vet sign, no letters).
The stacked boxes look like a volcano with a hole at the top. {HED} gasps and points; {PIP} and {BUN} stare up at it.
{fox} leans out of the shed window pouring a bucket of water onto the top of the box volcano; water bubbles and foams out of the top. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} step back.
Six pink worms wriggle out of the top and sides of the wet box volcano. {PIP}, {BUN}, {HED} and {fox} all jump back in surprise.
{zebra} proudly shows a red yo-yo on a string to {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} in the garden.
The yo-yo flies off the string in a zigzag path across the lawn (shown as a zigzag motion line); {zebra} reaches after it; {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} duck.
The yo-yo splashes into a big cup of yogurt that {yak} was holding; yogurt splatters all over {yak}'s face. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} wince.
{PIP} pulls a small towel out of a bag with a big zipper and hands it up to {yak}, whose face is covered in yogurt; {yak} licks its lips happily. {zebra}, {BUN} and {HED} smile.
The garden decorated with balloons and a long table. {PIP}, {BUN} and {HED} hang a garland. A moon lamp, a net and a glass of milk are on the table.

Guests arrive through the little door: {duck} wearing a golden crown, {panda} with a quilt, {turtle}, {fox} and {zebra}. {HED} points at the crowned duck. A toy rocket and a bowl of rice are on the table.

Evening, the garden dim. {GRUMBLE} holds up his lantern with a finger on his lips; all the guests go quiet. A dark cake with unlit candles sits on the table under a big umbrella; a sun-shaped lamp is off.
{GRUMBLE} lights the candles on the cake with his lantern; everyone cheers with raised arms. A plate of striped candy, a bowl of soup, a box, a yo-yo and a cup of yogurt are on the table.
A small garden stage with a red curtain. {PIP} wears a tiny top hat and stands at the front like a host. {BUN} and {HED} hold the curtain ropes.
On the stage, {BUN}, {HED}, {duck}, {panda}, {fox}, {zebra} and {goat} stand in a line each holding up a blank white card; {PIP} points at them. The cards are plain white with no writing.
At the end of the line, {GRUMBLE} holds a blank white card but has fallen asleep standing up, eyes closed, mouth open, a little snore bubble. The others look at him.
All the friends pretend to sleep, eyes closed, copying {GRUMBLE}. {PIP} stands in front with a finger on its beak looking straight at the sleeping {GRUMBLE}.
